meta: Connect carriers, accounting, marketplaces and payment tools to your PrestaShop store, tested with real orders. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Connect PrestaShop to shipping, accounting and marketplaces
overview: We connect your PrestaShop store to the tools around it, so you stop re-typing orders and stock. That may be a shipping carrier, accounting software, a marketplace such as Amazon or eBay, or a payment provider. We install and configure a maintained module when one fits and write a small custom link when it does not. We test with sample orders and walk you through how the data flows.

pkgs.blurb: One tool connected to your store and tested.
Two tools connected, with stock rules and order updates.
Up to three tools, including a custom link if needed.
list: Custom connection where no module exists

faq: Common ones are carrier services, QuickBooks, Xero, accounting exports for European tax, Amazon, eBay, Mailchimp and Klaviyo. Send us your list and we confirm what is possible.
Do I pay for the tools themselves?
Yes. Subscriptions, licences and marketplace fees go to the tool makers. Our price is only for the connection work.
What if the tool has no module for PrestaShop?
We check whether it has an API or file exchange we can use. If so, Premium includes a custom link. If not, we tell you before you order.
Who fixes it if a sync breaks later?
Our fixes cover the setup we built. Ongoing monitoring or later changes are quoted separately. Error alerts mean you will hear about problems early.
